Congress Reshuffles Key State In-Charges, Assigns New Roles

The Indian National Congress has implemented significant organizational changes, appointing new in-charges for several states. Former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel has been removed from his role as the party's in-charge for Punjab and has been assigned responsibility for Assam. Sachin Pilot has been appointed as the new in-charge for Punjab. These changes involve adjustments to the responsibilities of multiple party leaders.
